verdict.rationale: Cake exposes its cap table via an MCP server so external AI clients (Claude, Codex, Cursor) can query data in plain English, but this is read-only Q&A via third-party assistants rather than a built-in in-product assistant that can be delegated tasks. Missing for 10: a native embedded assistant UI inside Cake itself, task-execution/delegation capability (only read-only querying is documented), and independent evidence of real-world usage beyond first-party docs.
